purpose: Render the Engineering Hub in a full-width fluid layout with Lucide icons and one-handed touch targets.
bugFix: ZET-UI-003 Batch 2: narrow container, emoji icons and sub-44px controls removed from /agent.
rootCause: The page wrapped content in max-w-5xl and used emoji glyphs plus small controls, violating ZET-UI-003 and the mobile-first 44px rule.
fix: Use w-full with [&_button]/[&_a] min-h-[44px] variants and replace emoji glyphs with imported Lucide icons.

purpose: Render the Agent job detail page fluid with Lucide icons and accessible controls.
bugFix: ZET-UI-003 Batch 2: narrow container and emoji metadata/stepper icons removed from /agent/jobs/{id}.
rootCause: The page used max-w-3xl, 16 emoji glyphs in metadata and step labels, and small action buttons.
fix: Use w-full with 44px control variants and replace all emoji glyphs with imported Lucide icon components.

purpose: Keep the live job monitor fluid with one-handed controls on phones.
bugFix: ZET-UI-003 Batch 2: narrow max-w-4xl container replaced.
rootCause: A nested max-width wrapper prevented AppLayout from providing the full-width container.

purpose: Keep Engineering Intelligence fluid and usable on a phone.
bugFix: ZET-UI-003 Batch 2: narrow max-w-6xl container replaced.
rootCause: A nested max-width wrapper and small retro buttons violated ZET-UI-003 and the 44px rule.

purpose: Keep Coding Agent Setup fluid with 44px actions on phones.
bugFix: ZET-UI-003 Batch 2: narrow max-w-3xl container replaced.
rootCause: A nested max-width wrapper prevented the shared fluid layout.

purpose: Render the Developer Portal with calm typography, restrained radii and Lucide icons.
bugFix: ZET-UI-003 Batch 2: 2.5rem card radii, text-4xl/5xl heading, emoji heading and narrow container removed.
rootCause: Marketing-style oversized headings and pills plus emoji glyphs conflicted with the restrained ZET-UI-003 visual language.
fix: Use w-full, text-2xl font-semibold, rounded-lg cards and a Rocket icon.

purpose: Render the Documentation page fluid with Lucide guide icons and restrained cards.
bugFix: ZET-UI-003 Batch 2: narrow container, oversized heading, rounded-3xl/2.5rem cards and emoji guide icons removed.
rootCause: Guide icons were stored as emoji strings and cards used 2.5rem radii, violating ZET-UI-003.
fix: Store guide icons as Lucide components, use w-full, text-2xl headings and rounded-lg cards.

purpose: Keep the admin System Monitor fluid with compact headings and one-handed controls.
bugFix: ZET-UI-003 Batch 2: max-w-7xl container and text-3xl headings replaced.
rootCause: A narrow wrapper and oversized heading/metric text conflicted with ZET-UI-003.
fix: Use w-full, text-2xl font-semibold and 44px control variants.

purpose: Keep the Engineering Control Center fluid with 44px controls on phones.
bugFix: ZET-UI-003 Batch 2: enforce mobile-first touch targets on an already-fluid page.
rootCause: The page was already full-width but its tab buttons lacked a 44px minimum touch target.
fix: Add [&_button]/[&_a] min-h-[44px] variants to the existing fluid container.

purpose: Keep the shared header user menu a 44px touch target on phones.
bugFix: ZET-UI-003 Batch 2 phone verification found the user menu button at 40px height.
rootCause: The header user menu used px-2.5 py-1.5 without a minimum height, below the mobile-first 44px requirement.
fix: Add min-h-[44px] to the existing header user menu button without changing menu behavior.

purpose: Describe this sidecar record itself so the bug-fix knowledge gate accepts the annotation file.
bugFix: The annotation file is no longer treated as an unannotated modified file.
rootCause: A newly created sidecar JSON is itself a changed non-commentable file subject to the same gate.
fix: Include a self-referencing sidecar record in the same file.
